summary_en: A CRA notice stating the monthly Canada child benefit amount ($619.75) and the next payment date, September 18, 2026; no action is needed.
text:
Canada Revenue Agency
Canada child benefit notice
Date: September 4, 2026
Benefit year: July 2026 to June 2027
Based on your 2025 income tax return, your Canada child benefit is $619.75 per month for one child.
Your next payment will be deposited on September 18, 2026.
You do not need to do anything. Keep this notice for your records. If your marital status, number of children or address changes, tell us right away.
